{{Quote|My father was an admiral and my mother was a Senator, but they were both killed during the war.|Spirakris Zarem|<ref name="SWTORTPOD" />}}
The '''mother''' of [[Spirakris Zarem]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as a [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. She [[Marriage/Legends|married]] an [[Spirakris Zarem's father|admiral]] and had a daughter named Spirakris, but both she and her husband were [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the war.<ref name="SWTORTPOD" />
